def factor_volume_return_directional_corr(df):
    """Rolling correlation between daily return and volume deviation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_mean = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_dev = df_copy["volume"] / vol_mean - 1.0
    corr = daily_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=20).corr(vol_dev)
    factor = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_return_directional_corr"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_return_directional_corr"]
description: Rolling correlation between signed daily returns and volume deviation captures persistent directional volume coherence. Positive correlation means volume expands on up days and contracts on down days, confirming trend; negative correlation signals volume divergence. Unlike volume-weighted return differences, this pathway isolates the time-series relationship between return sign/magnitude and contemporaneous volume deviations.
